root_cause: Public language options persisted locale state but relied on the browser's implicit anchor default after mobile menu state mutated during the same click.
fix: Public language-option clicks prevent implicit navigation, close menus and call location.assign() with the canonical localized href.
prevention: Never rely on implicit anchor navigation for the public locale switch
Keep cross-page NL→EN→NL production browser proof fail-closed
Classify locale-click timeout as runtime interaction defect, not Netlify transport failure
